dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I went to a fortune teller yesterday. She seemed to know everything about me!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈwɛnt tu ə ˈfɔːrtʃən ˌtɛlər ˈjɛstərdeɪ. ʃiː ˈsiːmd tə ˈnoʊ ˈɛvriθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈmiː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She said that I had moved recently and that I had a new job.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈsɛd ðæt aɪ hæd ˈmuːvd ˈriːsəntli ənd ðæt aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈnuː ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, you always wear your work ID card, and your keys are new. That isn't hard to see!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, juː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈwɛr jʊr ˈwɜːrk ˌaɪˈdiː ˌkɑːrd, ənd jʊr ˈkiːz ər ˈnuː. ðæt ˈɪzənt ˈhɑːrd tə ˈsiː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe. But she also said that my grandfather's name started with J. And it does: James!
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈsɛd ðæt maɪ ˈɡrænfɑːðərz ˈneɪm ˈstɑːrtɪd wɪð ˈdʒeɪ. ənd ɪt ˈdʌz: ˈdʒeɪmz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That could be a coincidence. Lots of names start with J.
dialogue.reading: ðæt kʊd bi ə koʊˈɪnsɪdəns. ˈlɑːts əv ˈneɪmz ˈstɑːrt wɪð ˈdʒeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hmm. She also told me to wear pink every Tuesday for luck.
dialogue.reading: ˈhm. ʃiː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈtoʊld miː tə ˈwɛr ˈpɪŋk ˈɛvri ˈtuːzdeɪ fər ˈlʌk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's just a superstition. Many Thais wear a special color for each day.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈdʒʌst ə ˌsuːpərˈstɪʃən. ˈmɛni ˈtaɪz ˈwɛr ə ˈspɛʃəl ˈkʌlər fər ˈiːtʃ ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You don't seem to believe any of it.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈdoʊnt ˈsiːm tə bɪˈliːv ˈɛni əv ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I don't. But my mom appears to believe all of it! She wears green every Wednesday.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt. bʌt maɪ ˈmɑːm əˈpɪrz tə bɪˈliːv ˈɔːl əv ɪt! ʃiː ˈwɛrz ˈɡriːn ˈɛvri ˈwɛnzdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! Then maybe I'll wear pink, just in case.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈðɛn ˈmeɪbi aɪl ˈwɛr ˈpɪŋk, ˈdʒʌst ɪn ˈkeɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea. It doesn't seem to do any harm!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈsiːm tə ˈduː ˈɛni ˈhɑːrm!
